title: SG-8.2.4 Validation unit tests assert real dialog behaviour
summary: Rewrite ContributionSheet validation unit tests to assert real dialog behaviour and fail when the validation code is removed
description: Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) already blocks blank text, over-limit text and zero quota. Desired behavior: the unit tests assert the inline messages, counter text, disabled or blocked submit, and that submitContribution is never called. Expected result: each test fails if the matching guard in the component is removed. Why: tests that pass without the guards give false confidence.
acceptance_criteria: Given blank or whitespace text, when Send is clicked, then the inline message 'Enter an idea first' shows and submitContribution has 0 calls
Given text over MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH, when Send is clicked, then the over-limit message and the counter text show and submitContribution has 0 calls
Given zero remaining quota, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled, the quota message shows and a form submit does not call submitContribution
technical_constraints: Mock only the API client; render the real ContributionSheet
definition_of_done: All three requirements have passing unit tests that fail when their guard is removed
non_functional: Each test file runs in seconds
